tools.name: get_metadata_api_clfn_product_srv
tools.title: get_metadata_api_clfn_product_srv
tools.description:
Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption.
Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.
Call this endpoint every time before you call other tools to ensure understanding of the schema.
Based on the metadata, you can dynamically create an OData request.

Use filtering parameters to get specific metadata sections. Without parameters, this tool returns the complete XML metadata (which might be huge).
Only use the specified enum values for the filtering parameters.

tools.name: list_a_clfnproduct_for_api_clfn_product_srv
tools.title: list_A_ClfnProduct_for_api_clfn_product_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a list of entities from the A_ClfnProduct collection in the api_clfn_product_srv service. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, ranking ($top), skipping ($skip), expanding related entities, counting, selecting specific properties. Only use attributes in the query options that are specified in the metadata. If the structure of the entity is not known, call get_metadata_api_clfn_product_srv tool first to get the metadata.
